systems.country_label: paiements digitaux dans les centres d'état civil
systems.owner: collectivités territoriales, under the Ministère de l'Administration territoriale et de la Décentralisation; Direction nationale de l'état civil runs support and control missions
systems.tiers: each centre d'état civil; the meeting of 30 July 2026 was with the communes of Bamako District and the urban commune of Kati

note: Concerns digital payment of fees at civil status centres (nearly FCFA 200 million raised for local authorities between July 2024 and May 2026, and a 30-day reporting order of 30 July 2026), not how the centres make the record of a birth or death; no fact for the civil class.
